Name: Aarav Sharma

Work Experience:
- 2023--2024: Physics Research Intern, Indian Institute of Science. Assisted senior researchers in conducting experiments related to condensed matter physics, focusing on magnetic materials. Participated in literature review sessions, helping to identify relevant papers and advancements in the field.

Education:

- 2018--
